item: One owner record and one verdict (alive / dead / unknown) for every claim that means a job is running; the corpus lease and the rollup build marker now see a second server on the same data folder
refs: R183; R176 (lease file cost measured ~1.0 ms per take+release with the fsync)
summary: A swap in one server could not see a re-index batch in flight in another (the corpus lease was a per-process dict), and a second server read a running build's marker as a killed build. The backup staging owner test moved to src/safety/process_owner.py unchanged and is shared. The first holder of a lease name in a process now writes <data>/leases/<name>.<process>.lease (the owner record) and the last removes it; another process's file counts as held when its owner is alive or unknown (another host or machine: fail closed, named) and is swept when its owner is dead (the takeover); workers still never wait. The rollup marker carries its owner: dead owner = killed build as before, live or unjudgeable owner = build_running_elsewhere (a named skip that keeps no hold), checked and claimed under one file lock in begin(); progress/clear are locked read-change-write with a unique temp. Measured cost of a lease file: about 1 ms per take and release (fsynced, so a power cut cannot leave an empty one). An empty or garbled lease file older than 10 s is swept as a leftover (a file that cannot be read is never aged out; the lease carries no heartbeat, so a readable record of another host stays held and the refusal prints its file name under leases/ and its owner fields; a matching machine tag does not override a different hostname because machine ids are copied with cloned images, so a host renamed after a crash is cleared by hand). Stated limit: the swap wait narrows the cross-process hazard, it does not close it (the exclusive window and write gates stay per process); a hung NFS data folder blocks a lease take. Never run: Windows and NFS/FUSE lease files; containers sharing a folder under different hostnames read unknown (held) until the file is removed.
